notes.title: Massive Update: New Features, Campaigns Improvements, Multiplayer & Major Fixes!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463810/96006675d64b6e3e3c074e2a99cb67b4494bce03.jpg"]
Greetings, Strategists!
First and foremost, thank you all for your continued support and for helping build such a fantastic community!

We're thrilled to announce this massive update, packed with many of the most requested features and improvements from the community. Even more exciting—this marks the beginning of a new development approach: major content updates (features, improvements, and new mechanics) will now be released periodically as we work toward the full release out of Early Access.

And don’t miss it—a major announcement is coming this October! 😊


[hr][/hr]🛠️ Massive Update - Full Patch Notes Below:[hr][/hr]🆕 New Features & Content
New Icon System:

Unit icons now use the player's chosen color.

Icons dynamically change based on unit specialization.

Units display icons representing the weapons they are currently carrying.

Health bars are now visible for units garrisoned in buildings, vehicles, or ships.

Improved Unit Control System:

Units are grouped by infantry type.

Units are also grouped based on equipped weapons.

Special units are now organized distinctly from regular troops.

Enhanced selection interface for easier group-based unit control.

Victory & Defeat System:

Added unique Victory/Defeat screens for each civilization.

Special sound effects now play at the end of each match, customized for victories and defeats.

Statistics System:

Introduced a star rating system for high scores across all player stats.

Statistics now display correctly at all resolutions.

Added support for complex character fonts (e.g., Russian, Chinese).
[hr][/hr]🏛️ Civilizations
Spartans:

The Arena now passively generates elite Athenian units over time: Swords of Pericles. These units have unique abilities.

New Arena techs added to enhance the Swords of Pericles.

Macedonians:

The Arena now produces Citizen-Soldiers, militia units that evolve into heavy infantry when fully leveled.

New Arena upgrades added for Citizen-Soldiers.

Indians:

All Indian building models have received new textures, now more closely aligned with the civilization’s design(Thanks to chifeiyen for his work).
[hr][/hr]📜 Campaign Updates
Persian Campaign:

Secondary objectives and star bonuses added to Missions 4 and 6.

Mission 7 now includes a timer for its secondary objective.

Macedonian Campaign:

Secondary objectives and star bonuses added to Missions 4, 5, and 6.
[hr][/hr]⚔️ Conquest/Domination Mode
Map Reworks:

(2) Honest Duel – Enhanced environment, improved textures, and better gameplay feel.

(4) Green Valley – Complete visual overhaul, improved player spawn points, fixed terrain height issues, and better pathing.

(4) Bloody Hills – Improved textures and environmental elements.

(4) BloodBath – Enhanced terrain textures and visual polish.
[hr][/hr]✨ Gameplay Enhancements
Hotkey icons added to all command panel buttons for quicker access.

New campaign objective window: now shows primary goals directly in-game.

A red alert now appears in the Hint Window if you're lacking resources or population to perform actions.

Performance Boost: FPS optimization for high unit count scenarios (10–20% improvement depending on hardware).

Significantly improved unit pathfinding—units no longer get stuck.

Refined wind system behavior for more consistent effects.

First upgrade to ship pathfinding and collision: ships now rarely get stuck or lost.

Overhauled ship boarding mechanics—boarding combat now functions reliably.

Updated minimap textures for all civilizations.
[hr][/hr]🐞 Bug Fixes & Stability Improvements
Campaign Fixes

Persian Campaign:

Fixed a bug in Mission 3 where Spartans failed to build their base.

Corrected star bonus display error in Mission 3.

Fixed Mission 7 allowing secondary objectives after the time limit.

Macedonian Campaign:

Fixed an issue in Mission 2 where freeing the miners didn't properly trigger mission completion.
[hr][/hr]
Multiplayer Fixes:

Critical Fix: Resolved desync issue after ~30+ minutes of gameplay.

Rare Desync Fix: Fixed a hard-to-detect desync caused by the wind system.

Resolved several critical crashes due to data corruption.

Fixed instances of temporary FPS drops during certain conditions.

Addressed scenarios causing extreme lag spikes.

Fixed desync when using Macedonians in Conquest/Domination mode.

Fixed desync caused by Persian Healer’s healing tent.

Fixed various desyncs involving naval boarding actions.
[hr][/hr]
Gameplay Fixes:

Fixed bug where some units would become immobile and unusable.

Fixed rare bug where large armies could freeze and stop responding.

Fixed issue with units getting stuck under bridges during combat.

Fixed bug preventing units from boarding enemy ships properly.

Fixed crash during naval boarding with certain units.

Fixed bug preventing units from scaling enemy walls via Siege Towers when terrain height varied.

Fixed exploit allowing the Persian healing shop ability to be stacked repeatedly.




I hope you like this update and feel free to give your feedback or any suggestions as always.


Official Discord of the game:Link

notes.title: Massive Update Available! Egyptian Campaign, Siege and Wall System,New Maps, etc
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463810/96006675d64b6e3e3c074e2a99cb67b4494bce03.jpg
Greeting Strategists!

First of all, thank you all for continuing to be very supportive of the project and creating such a fantastic community.

The community means everything to me, which is why I’ve worked tirelessly to include many of the features you’ve been asking for in this update. I truly hope this makes the game even more enjoyable for you, and I can’t wait to bring you even more improvements in future updates as we march toward the full release! 😊

Below is the list with all the content of this update:

New features/content:

 Egyptian Campaign (9 missions, all featuring secondary objectives and bonus systems)
 Updated Wall System:
- Walls now require entrances to station units on them
- Unit placement on walls has been improved to allow proper defense building
- Units no longer dismount from walls when moved along them (unless there's no available placement space)
- Pathfinding for wall climbing now works as intended
- Sieges with ladders or siege towers against enemy walls function correctly
- Unit Pathfinding for siege equipment like ladders and towers is now optimized
- AI now builds entrances into walls
- AI now uses walls defensively during sieges and positions units properly (future updates will enhance AI's defensive and siege strategies)
- Unit collisions on walls have been optimized
 Maps:
- New Conquest/Domination Mode Map: (2) Honest Duel
 Reworked and Balanced Maps:
- (2) The Liberation of Sparta
- (2) Rebellion in Egypt
- (2) Hero Path
(All maps will receive reworks and balancing in future updates to ensure perfection.)
 Unit Colision & Formation System:
- Better Unit Collision System
- Enhanced Formation System (Formations now perform better with large groups of units)
- Improved Unit Handling System (Better responsiveness and control when managing large groups of units)
 Workshop Enhancements:
- Added Automatic Image Upload System for item previews in the Workshop (Uploaded or updated maps now generate preview images without user input)
- Users can now upload custom preview images for Workshop items (Use "steampreview.png" in the created map folder)
- Default minimaps are now displayed in-game menus if no custom minimap is provided
- Fixed Minimaps in Editor (No longer displays a minimap from a previously loaded map in menus)
 FPS Optimization for High-Unit-Count Scenarios (Performance boost of 10-20% depending on PC specs)
 Improved Unit Pathfinding
 Added Full Russian Voice Localization
 Enhanced AI Unit Production System (AI now produces units more intelligently)
 AI now chooses war vehicles and animals more effectively
 AI now builds siege towers when necessary 
 Added Option in Map Editor to place entrances on wall nodes and towers
 Removed Mercenaries from Garrisons
 Added Missing Capture Animations for all units
 Added Victory Sound when completing campaigns
 Improvements to Some Creep Units in Conquest/Domination Mode maps



Bug/Error Correction:

 Multiplayer Fixes:
- Resolved All Multiplayer Desync Triggers in Conquest/Domination Mode (Multiplayer is now fully stable across all maps except Naval Ones)
- Fixed All Desync Triggers for Republican Rome (All civilizations except Imperial Rome are now multiplayer-ready)
- Fixed Arena Multiplayer Bug in Republican Rome (Prevented players from repeatedly recruiting mercenary templates with fast clicks)
 Fixed Bug in Mercenary Camp in Conquest/Domination Mode (Previously prevented the building from being assigned to the player)
 Fixed Bug in Certain Heroes that incorrectly applied an oversized health multiplier when leveling up
 Fixed Text Glitches (Symbols like "??" no longer appear in all languages)
 Fixed Reported Bugs from the Persian Campaign
 Fixed Secondary Quest Activation Bug in Spartan Campaign’s first mission (Players can now obtain the 7 stars)
 Fixed Persian Campaign Mission 3 Bug (Spartan troops now correctly spawn on triremes, and enemy obelisks use their special abilities)
 Fixed Hero Combat Spell for Marcus Aurelius (Now functions correctly, including its unique projectile effect)
 Fixed Worker Command Display Bug for Support Units


Balance:

 Balanced Wall Construction Cost and Time (Walls are now more practical and useful in gameplay)
 Balanced Fire Catapult Damage for triremes and added a unique fire projectile model when researching Greek Fire
 Balanced Siege Tower Costs


I hope you like this update and feel free to give your feedback or any suggestions as always.

Official Discord of the game:Link

notes.title: Update 0.70: Steam Workshop Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463810/5ba0929c539ce72a869cd97377456cd64f7ea6e1.jpg
Greeting Strategists!
First of all, thank you all for supporting the project and continuing to build such a fantastic community.

It is a pleasure to announce this great update, which stands out for adding a feature that many of you wanted, such as Steam Workshop support(how to use it is described below). 

You already know that the community is the most important thing for me and I hope that this addition helps you to enjoy the game a little more.

I hope you like this update and feel free to give your feedback or any suggestions as always.

Official Discord of the game:Link

Steam Workshop User Guide:

To create a Workshop item and upload it:

1 - Open the game's Map Editor

2 - Create the map with all the features or modifications you want (You can create maps for new game modes, mission maps, great battles, simple skirmish maps, etc...)

3 - Save the map you have created

4 - In the editor toolbar, look for the File option, click and select the Steam Workshop option, where you can publish the Map in the Workshop or Update a Map that you have previously uploaded. 

You can look at the screenshot to see where the Steam Workshop option is located in the Editor.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42531213/981cf1715917d5513d2e6183cdde27597b068700.png

5 - Finally, change the Item information in the Steam Workshop to your liking

To subscribe and download a Workshop map:

1 - Enter the game Workshop, from the game meeting point

2 - Browse the available maps

3 - Subscribe to the map you want to download

It will download automatically and appear in the game along with the other available maps

4 - If you want to delete a downloaded map, simply unsubscribe from it in the Workshop

notes.title: Massive Update Available! Asymmetrical Civilizations, Balance, Optimization, etc
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463810/96006675d64b6e3e3c074e2a99cb67b4494bce03.jpg
Greeting Strategists!

First of all, thank you all for continuing to be very supportive of the project and creating such a fantastic community.

I have never asked the community for anything, but this time I would value that if you like this massive update to the game, please contribute a positive review of the game. It will help keep me motivated to do such big updates that take many months and hard work to complete.

Below is the list with all the content of this update(Some changes are summarized below, due to the large number of changes that have been made):

New features/content:

 Rework of all civilizations to make them much more asymmetric.
 Role system for weapons (each weapon has bonuses against certain types of units, increasing the strategic aspect).
 Added optimization to the game: about 10% performance increase(depends of user PC).
 Added time cost indicator for all objects that require time for their production or construction (Buildings, units, researches, etc...).
 New sorting system in the selection of units, now grouped in a more intuitive and easy to control by the player.
 New features for the special buildings of each civilization.
 Rework of the wonders of each civilization and new bonuses or abilities in each one.
 Replaced researchable skills for some infantry units in each civilization by more useful ones.
 Replaced some special skills in certain special units with more useful ones.
 Added memory protection system for when using numerous spells simultaneously (Fixes a great number of crashes).
 Added penalty effect on ranged units when attacked by a melee unit.
 New AI in many missions of the Spartan, Macedonian and Roman campaigns.
 Optimization improvements for numerous missions of the Spartan and Macedonian campaigns.
 New features in all capturable buildings in the Conquest/Domination game mode.
 Optimization in some maps of the Conquest/Domination game mode.
 AI improvements and balance on all difficulties.
 Spells now do not affect units that were previously affected and should not (for example units that are not controlled by any player).
 Added Cloak for the Princep unit of Republican Rome.
 Updated the font of some dialogues and messages with a more modern and beautiful one.
 Added invisibility effect on Spartan arena special units when they activate their ghost attack ability.
 Improved mercenary units in some Conquest/Domination game mode maps.
 Better environment in some missions of the Spartan and Macedonian Campaigns.
 Improvements in the environment of some maps in the Conquest/Domination game mode.
 Camera improvements in some missions of the Spartan and Macedonian Campaigns.
 Translation improvements in some languages.



Bug/Error Correction:

 Fixed many bugs in all the missions of the Spartan, Macedonian and Roman campaigns.
 Fixed bugs that caused occasional crashes when loading a saved game.
 Fixed critical bug that forced to restart the game after each multiplayer game to avoid the desync.
 Fixed all desync triggers for Spartan and Macedonian civilizations (the rest of civilizations are still being worked on).
 Fixed AI not working for some players in some Missions in the Spartan, Macedonian and Roman campaigns.
 Fixed bug that caused the overlapping of the penalty suffered by ranged units when attacked by a melee unit that caused their damage to be zero when attacked by numerous melee units.
 Fixed a bug in the Republican Roman heavy shield, which was not saved when the unit was throwing torches.
 Fixed bug in which the flags of settlements healed neutral units.


Balance:

 Balance of the statistics of all weapons and prices of the weapons and their upgrades.
 Balance in all missions of the Spartan, Macedonian and Roman campaigns.
 Reduced damage of fire arrows to buildings and fortifications.
 Balance for the special units of each civilization.
 Balanced numerous spells.


I hope you like this update and feel free to give your feedback or any suggestions as always.

Official Discord of the game:Link

notes.title: Important announcement & Roadmap for the coming months!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463810/674f6dbe8e88cb63c79b508329a04aef402e3dfd.jpg
Greetings Strategists!

First, thank you to all of you who are supporting Ancient Wars: Sparta Definitive Edition.

As always, satisfying the community is the most important thing to me, so I'm pleased to officially announce that some content you've been asking for, is coming to the game. 

This content is:

 Original Spartan Campaign, remastered and improved
 Original Persian Campaign, remastered and improved
 Original Egyptian Campaign, remastered and improved
 Videos of the original campaigns Remastered
 Original Voice Overs for other languages


So the game will finally have 6 campaigns instead of the originally planned 3, I hope this satisfies your nostalgia and gives you many more hours of gameplay.

On the other hand, many of you have asked about the game development plans, so I have decided to publish the content and improvements that will arrive over the next 6 months. To have the best possible communication and transparency with the community.

The content and improvements that the game will receive during the next 6 months are:

 Original Persian campaign, remastered and improved
 Redesign of the gameplay and characteristics of each faction (Each faction will be unique and more asymmetrical)
 Steam Workshop Introduction
 Multiplayer Improvement (Global Chat, stability, bug fixes)
 Balance of all civilizations (The game will finally be balanced)
 Redesign of Current Maps(All will be perfect)
 Quality of Life Improvements
 Bug Fixes


I hope you like the development plans and say that there is still a lot to come, as always leave your suggestions or opinions in the comments. Community is always the most important thing to me!

notes.title: Second Anniversary Update: Romans Campaign, New Features & Improvements, Fixes!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463810/96006675d64b6e3e3c074e2a99cb67b4494bce03.jpg
Greeting Strategists!

First of all, thank you all for continuing to be very supportive of the project and creating such a fantastic community.

Many of you wanted and voted for a new campaign focused on the Romans, so it is a pleasure to announce its launch, along with new features and improvements, which I hope will help you enjoy the game a little more.

Below is the list with all the content of this update:

New features/content:

 New Campaign: Romans - The Beginning of an Empire
 Worker system: After constructing a building, workers detect the number of workers required by the building and auto go to work in it.
 Improved Construction Queues: Construction queues are maintained even after the construction of buildings that require workers, if there are free workers available.
 New Stance System: More convenient to use, in which you can simply assign holding position and the units return to the defensive position automatically when necessary.
 Starvation System for Horses: Horses that have lost their rider and have been damaged, suffer a starvation effect, until another rider mounts them. (Avoiding the piling up of horses that remain after the battle on the map and are not used )
 New Sounds and Environment Effects
 Updated Vulkan Support
 Caravans System for all Civilizations
 Better environment for Vardar Sea Battle map.
 Clouds effect added to all Spartan and Macedonian campaign missions.
 Music Volume Adjustments


Bug/Error Correction:

 Fix Bug that did not correctly save the AI ​​difficulty in games when it was Medium or Hard.
 Fix Bug of Combat Spell of Scipio The African that does not work(not throw poisoned knife)
 Fix Bug where Cleopatra convert dead units into servants of Amon, causing zombie units on the map
 Fix Bug for: When a building is damaged, it stops displaying the production or research list progress bar
 Fix Desync and Crash caused by the Praetorians ability in Imperial Rome.
 Fix Desync and Crash related to Unit Stances
 Fix Bug of Testudo Formation ability, which was not deactivated correctly when mounting the unit on a horse, causing stacking of its modifiers.
 Fix Bug of Testudo Formation ability, which did not show the command to deactivate the ability when it is activated
 Fix Bug of Mission 5 of the Spartan Campaign, which did not activate the starvation effect on the enemy after finishing off the food caravans
 Fix Bug of Mission 1 of the Macedonia Campaign, which did not activate the starvation effect on the enemy after burning the village with enemy farms.


Balance:

 Removed damage bonus for mounted units equipped with ranged weapons


I hope you like this update and feel free to give your feedback or any suggestions as always.

notes.title: Open PlayTest Is Coming!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41463810/e9496acf5d62cea125de1634c608a38c50900619.jpg

Greetings, Strategy lovers!

Due to the great reception of the Closed Beta, we are happy to announce that there will be an Open Beta before the launch of the game on January 28, 2022, where you can test the new additions to the game since the Closed Beta and the improvements applied to the game following the feedback received from the community during the Beta, we can't wait for you to enjoy the amazing gameplay and new features of Ancient Wars: Sparta Definitive Edition before launch.

Ancient Wars: Sparta Definitive Edition Open PlayTest begins January 12 and will continue until January 17.

Open PlayTest Access

You can register for the PlayTest on the Steam page of the Game Store to be notified when the Open PlayTest is available or you can simply give it to play freely in the PlayTest section from January 12th.

The number of participants will be unlimited, so that everyone will have free access to the Open PlayTest from January 12th.

Open PlayTest FAQ

Where can I get access to the Open PlayTest?
Steam Store Link

What regions is the Open PlayTest available in?
WorldWide.

What content will the Open PlayTest have?
It is a PlayTest so the content will be reduced compared to the release version in Early Access and the final release, the Open PlayTest will have the following content:
- 4 Civilizations: Spartans, Persians, Egyptians and Macedonians.
- Game modes: Classic Skirmish, Conquest and Domination.
- 12 Maps: 9 for Classic Skirmish, 3 for Conquest and Domination.
- Multiplayer

What languages is the Open PlayTest available in?
The Open PlayTest will support voice-over and text in English only.

Can I talk / post / create content about / or stream the Open PlayTest?
Yes, during the Open PlayTest you are allowed to record, or broadcasting any content or gameplay. We also welcome your feedback on our Official Game Discord or Steam Store Forum.

Can I collect footage from the Open PlayTest to use in later content if that content is released later?
Yes, you can capture footage of the Open PlayTest to use at a later date. However, there will be changes and updates between Open PlayTest  and launch that may cause captured content to be inaccurate or out of date.

See you in the conquest of the Ancient World!!

Link

notes.title: Closed Beta is coming!
notes.content:

As we prepare for our January 28, 2022 launch, we’re eager to show players to the incredible gameplay and new features of Ancient Wars: Sparta Definitive Edition during our Closed Beta test. 

Ancient Wars: Sparta Definitive Edition Closed Beta begins December 2 and will continue until December 6.

Closed Beta Eligibility & Access

Players are eligible to participate in the Closed Beta through signup in PlayTest Access on Store Page in Steam of the game: Steam Store Link

Number of participants to get access will be limited, so if you sign up early, you will get insured access to the Closed Beta. Be sure to check your email throughout the testing period to see if you receive an advise about the Beta launch.

Steam Store Link

WorldWide.

The Closed Beta will support voice-over and text in English only.

Can I collect footage from the Closed Beta to use in later content if that content is released later?
Yes, you can capture footage of the Closed Beta to use at a later date. However, there will be changes and updates between Closed Beta and launch that may cause captured content to be inaccurate or out of date.
